messages:
Tara Lopez: Customer ask: Greypoint wants a hands-on migration clinic next Wed. They asked for a single 75m session that covers a dry run + lab. Can we slot something that hits EMEA evening / APAC morning overlap?
Mike Huang: I can lead the demo if we put it in the early overlap. What's the attendee mix?
Tara Lopez: ~20 people: 10 eng, 6 infra/platform, 4 PMs. Main asks: version pinning, routing failovers, cost tuning (quant/batching), and a short rollback/runbook test.
Jana Park: Timezone proposal: 15:00-16:15 UTC (covers late EMEA to early APAC). Alternative 14:00-15:15 UTC. Which is preferable for Dedicated workshop folks? :thinking_face:
Sanjay Patel: Heads-up: we have an internal Dedicated onboarding at 14:30 UTC that day. Prefer 15:00 start so we don't clash. I can support the runbook segment if it's 15:00.
Tara Lopez: Ok sounds like 15:00-16:15 UTC is the best compromise. Jana can you open a quick poll and we can confirm?
Jana Park: Poll posted: `poll: ["15:00-16:15 UTC", "14:00-15:15 UTC"]` will close in 90m. I'll provision recording and a breakout lab channel.
Remi (calendar-bot): Provisional event created: Greypoint Hands-on Migration Clinic  provisional on CS calendar. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/greypoint-hands-on (will update after poll).
Mike Huang: I'll prepare a 10-slide agenda + 30m guided lab. Need a test snapshot of their tenant config or a minimal repro. Can CS request a sanitized snapshot?
Tara Lopez: I'll request a sanitized config and attendee emails. Also sending a 3-question pre-survey: 1) primary goal 2) current blocker 3) preferred follow-up cadence.
Sanjay Patel: For the lab: I'll draft rollback steps and the fallback policy snippet. Recommend we show `model_variant_fallback: automatic -> conservative` and KV cache warmup commands.
Jana Park: Prework checklist (posting here): 1) attendee list by EOD Tue 2) pre-survey to attendees 3) test dataset + access instructions 4) demo deck link 5) runbook draft in shared drive.
Tara Lopez: Feedback form link (for renewal signal capture): https://forms.gle/redwood-greypoint-feedback . Questions capture "confidence level post-clinic" and "open risks". Please encourage attendees to fill out.
Mike Huang: I'll upload the demo deck and runner script by Monday COB. Also adding short clip snippets for the most sensitive steps.
Remi (calendar-bot): Poll closed  majority selected `15:00-16:15 UTC`. Event confirmed and invites sent. Recording enabled. Channel created: #greypoint-hands-on-clinic.
Jana Park: Shared folder: https://drive.redwood.example/greypoint-clinic (slides, runbook, prework). I'll post final agenda there and ping the channel.
Tara Lopez: Great work team. Moving follow-ups to the new channel. Closing this scheduling thread.
